description: An app analytics dashboard with a metric switcher, a weekly area chart, a regional breakdown and a tab bar.
overview: Composes `Screen`, `Header`, `DropdownMenu` for picking the app, `ToggleGroup`, the `AreaChart` from `Chart`, `Item` rows and `TabBar`. Switching the metric or app redraws the chart, and dragging across the chart updates the headline value for that week. The other tabs show a placeholder section.
usage: Replace `apps`, `metrics` and `regions` with your analytics data. Pass `onAppChange`, `onMetricChange` and `onNavigate` to sync the selections with your app.
